description: Accessiboss client reports (Agency plan, enforced on the server). action list (default; reports of one site: period, kind, open, fixed, new and returned counts, plus the report settings and the agency's own name and logo), get (reportId; the full numbers), html (reportId; the printable page as HTML), generate (site; makes a report for the last 30 days now; confirm), settings (site; any of monthly true/false and locale fi/sv/en, and brandName and logoUrl = https address of your logo; confirm), share (reportId; days 1 to 90, default 14; creates a signed link that expires, to hand to your client yourself; confirm), revoke_share (reportId; every link to that report stops working; confirm). Monthly reports are made by the platform early each month and shown in the portal. Nothing here ever mails a client. Reports say what automated checks found, and that the site owner stays responsible.

action.description: list is default. generate, settings, share and revoke_share need confirm. Agency plan. Nothing is mailed to a client.

brandName.description: settings: the agency's own name on the report.

logoUrl.description: settings: https address of the agency's logo; empty removes it.

monthly.description: settings: make a report every month.

reportId.description: get, html, share, revoke_share: report id from action list.

site.description: Accessiboss site: id, public key or domain. Optional when the account has one site.
